name: Nationality by Naturalization

requirements.blocker_text: Naturalization by residence generally requires 5 consecutive years of uninterrupted legal residence in Burkina Faso. The new Code des personnes et de la famille (2025) is also reported to have tightened general naturalization scrutiny -- requiring applicants to affirmatively demonstrate that all legal conditions are met, and removing prior 'possession of status' presumptions that previously eased some applications.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 consecutive years of legal residence in Burkina Faso, then apply, demonstrating that all statutory conditions are independently met.

evidence_required.document: Proof of lawful means of support

sources.title: Openshores (private immigration-guide site) -- 5-year continuous legal residence requirement for naturalization
AFRILEX (University of Bordeaux law journal) -- notes the new 2025 code's tightened naturalization scrutiny, removing prior possession-of-status presumptions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Burkina Faso). STATUS: DRAFT -- the 5-year figure is sourced only to a private blog (tier 4); the primary legal text's own specific residency article number was not successfully extracted in this build (see bf_citizenship_by_descent.json's notes on the same access gap). Consistent with bf_citizenship_by_marriage.json's finding, the new 2025 code trends toward MORE scrutiny generally, not less -- a real, current, disclosed pattern across this country's citizenship framework, in contrast to countries in this dataset that have liberalized (e.g. DR Congo's 2004 reform). dual_citizenship_allowed left null: no source reviewed addressed general dual-nationality policy under the new code -- this is a genuine unresolved gap across all three of this country's settled-category files, not assumed either way.
